answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 13149 Country: India Title: If I reached in jama prayer in 2nd raka I have to recite sana (Subahankallahuma bihamdika?????) with my niyat or I have to recite when imam finish rakat and I stand up for one rakat which I missed? Question: If I reached in jama prayer in 2nd raka I have to recite sana (Subahankallahuma bihamdika?????) with my niyat or I have to recite when imam finish rakat and I stand up for one rakat which I missed? Answer ID: 13149 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 797/672=L/1430) In case of joining the second rak?ah, you should not recite sana ( س بحانک اللھم بحمدک ۔۔۔ ), rather you should recite it when you stand up for making up the missed rak?ah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
